ending.solidarity.title: Solidarity
ending.solidarity.desc: The family held on to each other. The factory changed, but they did not lose one another.
ending.separation.title: Separation
ending.separation.desc: No one harmed anyone. But everyone went their own way.
ending.bitter_reckoning.title: Bitter Reckoning
ending.bitter_reckoning.desc: Someone paid the price for this shift. Karaliman will not forget.
ending.betrayal.title: Betrayal
ending.betrayal.desc: A name was given. After that, no table was ever the same.
ending.secret.title: Secret Ending: The Silent Table
ending.secret.desc: All three alive, all three at the same table. And none of them says a word.
ch00.title: Test: Morning Tea
ch00.l01: Karaliman, twenty to six in the morning. The factory whistle hasn't blown yet, but the whole neighbourhood is awake.
ch00.l02: Dad, early shift again? It's not even light out.
ch00.l03: The new robot line goes live today. The final check is on us.
ch00.l04: Everyone at school is talking. They say once the line runs, they won't need maintenance crews.
ch00.c01.truth: It's true. Maybe half of us will go.
ch00.c01.reassure: Don't worry, someone has to fix the machines.
ch00.c01.deflect: Mind your exam. The rest is my business.
ch00.r01_truth: Then I'll find a job too. I'll drop school for a year.
ch00.r01_reassure: I hope so. But your voice says otherwise.
ch00.r01_deflect: You always say that. And then nobody ever tells me anything.
ch00.r01_silence: Kemal stirred his tea. The sound of the spoon lasted longer than any sentence.
ch00.l05: A truck horn outside the door. Rıza is early again.
ch00.l06: Kemal, brother! I'm heading to the port, I'll pass the factory. Hop in, we need to talk.
ch00.l06_no_kemal: Defne… I came about your father. We need to talk.
ch00.l07_angry: Go. You weren't going to tell me anything anyway.
ch00.c02.ask: Talk about what? Say it here.
ch00.c02.defne_ride: Let's drop Defne at school too.
ch00.r02_ride: Something's off with the port cargo, brother. Unsealed containers. Have you heard anything?
ch00.r02_ride_b: I haven't. And I don't want to, Rıza.
ch00.r02_bus: Suit yourself. But taking the shuttle won't make this go away.
ch00.r02_ask: Not here. In this neighbourhood even the walls have ears.
ch00.r02_defne: Thanks, Rıza. Dad never asks anything anyway.
ch00.r02_defne_b: Your father doesn't ask, kid. But he knows everything.
ch00.r02_silence: Kemal didn't answer. Rıza shrugged and drove off.
ch00.l09_warm: The streetlights went out. The day hadn't started badly.
ch00.l09_cold: The streetlights went out. Nobody wished anybody a good day.
ch00.l09_neutral: The streetlights went out. A new shift was starting in Karaliman.
journal.ch00.automation: The robot line goes live today. Half the maintenance crew may be made redundant.
journal.ch00.containers: Rıza mentioned unsealed containers at the port.
